newsitem.title: USA: CME to introduce options, half tick for Euroyen.
newsitem.headline: CME to introduce options, half tick for Euroyen.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange said it has filed for regulatory approval to trade options on its Euroyen futures starting July 1.

At the same time, the minimum price change for the two near-month Euroyen futures would be halved to one-half basis point (0.005 point), equalling 1,250 yen, from one basis point at present, the exchange added.
"The tighter markets that result from half-tick trading will provide an added edge for effective risk management," Leo Melamed, CME chairman emeritus and senior policy adviser, said in a statement.
